description: Scrape comprehensive hotel listings from Booking.com including amenities, cancellation policy, breakfast, original prices, and coordinates.

checkinDate.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to use tomorrow's date automatically.
checkinDate.title: Check-in Date

checkoutDate.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to default to 3 days after check-in.
checkoutDate.title: Check-out Date

location.description: City, region, or destination to search (e.g., 'Paris', 'New York', 'Tokyo')
location.title: Location

maxResults.description: Maximum number of hotel listings to scrape.
maxResults.title: Maximum Results

minRating.description: Minimum guest review score (0-10). Only properties rated at or above this score will be returned.
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is required — Booking.com blocks datacenter IPs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

title: Booking.com Hotel Scraper Input
